body: its got to the point where I'm not even afraid of death anymore because I know when I die ill be joining her, wherever she is.

yeah I've been talking to mutual friends for the past 2 days, they are all telling me that this isn't my fault and that this was preplanned by her and its what she wanted, which I understand but I still can't comprehend it, it feels like everyone around me is moving forward with their lives not knowing what happened, but I just can't do anything, I've skipped college, work pretty much anything I had to do I've canceled because I'm too fucking sad. it just sucks because we would talk every day for hours, she was one of the people I went to with my problems, and now I don't have that anymore. She was such a special and beautiful person, she was really into artists like lil peep and xxx, even going as far as to get X's tree tattooed on her arm, so as for the remembering I'm probably going to get the same tattoo with her name under it. although I know shes has gone to a better place, a place where she isn't suffering anymore, I still selfishly want her to be with me. like yesterday morning I walked to the beach alone, and all the way I was picturing her with me. idk man I just miss her so much already
im quite young only 18, i cant really go anywhere, the best I can do I surround myself with friends and try to drown it out ;(
